name: commit
tagline_zh: 改完代码懒得写提交信息？它自动分析 diff，生成规范语义提交，连类型和范围都帮你定好，省下敲键盘的功夫。
tagline_en: Tired of writing commit messages? It reads your diff and crafts semantic commits, auto-detecting type and scope.
desc_en: Smart Git commit helper that analyzes changes and creates semantic commits
why_zh: 同类工具多只套模板，它真正理解改动内容，按 Conventional Commits 精准分类。
why_en: Unlike template-fillers, it truly understands your changes, classifying per Conventional Commits and flagging breaking changes.
